faqBestQ: Which Goodwill near {city} has the highest Visit score?
faqBestA: In our published dataset, the {place} location has the highest Visit score ({score, number} out of 100). The score combines neighborhood Census measures, walkability data when available, and Google ratings when available. It does not measure inventory, prices, or value.
faqScoreQ: How does Thriftly rank Goodwill stores in {city}?
faqScoreA: The 0 to 100 Visit score combines a neighborhood Census baseline with walkability data when available and Google ratings when available. Its Census baseline uses four measures: median home value, household income, share of college graduates, and median rent. The score helps compare areas; it does not predict store inventory or value.
faqCountQ: How many Goodwill locations are in {city}?
faqCountA: Thriftly lists {count, plural, one {# Goodwill store} other {# Goodwill stores}} within {radius, number} miles of {city}, using published store data from AllThePlaces and OpenStreetMap. Listings may be missing or outdated, so coverage can be incomplete.

outletSource: Source checked November 4, 2026. This is a selected operator-sourced guide, not a complete list of every outlet in the region.
operatorBody: Check current hours, prices and shopping rules on the operator’s website. Local policies can change, and this guide does not promise today’s inventory or a particular price.
regularBody: The city guide lists mapped Goodwill locations with directions and Visit scores. Outlet merchandise and regular-store inventory can differ; the score does not predict what you will find at either.
methodTitle: How the Thriftly Visit score works
methodDescription: See how Census measures, walkability data, and Google ratings when available contribute to the Visit score, along with data dates and limitations. The score is not an inventory or value prediction.
methodIntro: The Visit score is a 0 to 100 planning estimate to help compare places to explore. It combines neighborhood Census measures, walkability data when available, and Google ratings when available.
fourMeasures: Four Census measures in the neighborhood baseline
catchment: We use Census tracts whose center points lie within {radius, number} miles of the store. Each measure is averaged using population and distance: more populous, closer tracts contribute more. This is a geographic approximation, not a study of who donates to that store.
normalization: Each measure is normalized against fixed ranges in our open-source model. Home value uses a logarithmic scale. Missing measures contribute zero, so a low score can reflect missing data. A score of 80 is not an 80th-percentile ranking or an 80% chance of finding something.
dataBody: The scoring model uses the 2022 American Community Survey five-year estimates. Store listings use AllThePlaces, supplemental OpenStreetMap records, and official store locators. AllThePlaces publishes its data under CC0; OpenStreetMap data has its own attribution and license requirements.
refresh: Refreshes are attempted weekly. If a source fails validation, the last complete published file stays in use; a schedule does not guarantee weekly updates.
verify: Use it to plan, then verify
verifyBody: Listings can be missing or outdated. Check the operator’s website before traveling. A Visit score cannot tell you what a store has today. Thriftly is independent and is not affiliated with the stores listed here.
